summary.p: In this second volume, Franklin Edgerton has edited four different recentions of the Vikramacarita; the first volume contains the translation. The parallels to the Vahnipurāṇa śiber upākhyāna are found in the southern recension of stories 11 and 13.
This copy, from the Princeton Theological Seminary, was digitized by the Internet Archive in 2022.

lg.l: tyaktvāhitvā'tmasukhasvasukhabhogecchāṃ, sarvasarveṣāṃ hi supare 'py anyasusattvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ,guṇaiṣiṇaḥ,śubheṣiṇaḥ,sukhehiṇaḥ (so, ṇ!)sukheṣiṇaḥ
bhavanti paraduḥkhena sādhavo 'tyantaduḥkhitāḥ.santo 'bhyantaraduḥkhitāḥ.sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ.sādhavo 'tyantaduḥkhinaḥ. 7

body.p:
rājānam abravīt: bho mahāpuruṣa, parārthaṃ śarīraṃ prayacchatas
tavaiva jīvitaṃ ślāghyam. kutaḥ:

lg.l: paśavo 'pi hi jīvantina hi jīvantaḥ kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ;kevalāḥ svodaraṃbharāḥ;kevalātmopalambhatāḥ;kevalātmodaraṃbhakāḥ;
tasyaiva jīvitaṃ ślāghyaṃ yaḥ parārthaṃparārthe hituca jīvati 8

body.p: bhavādṛśāṃ parkopakāriṇām etac citraṃ na bhavati. uktaṃ ca:

lg.l: kim atra citraṃ yat santaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ?
na hi svadehaśaityārthaṃśaityāya jāyante candanadrumāḥ. 9

body.p:
anyac ca: bho mahāsattva, anenaiva paropakāreṇa tvaṃ sarvāḥ
saṃpadaḥ prāpnoṣi. tathā coktam:

lg.l: sa saṃpadaṃsaṃpadaṃsaṃpadaṃ sasaṃpadassa saṃpadas samāpnotisamavāpnotiparam āpnoti parād api ca yat param.paratrā 'pi paraṃ padam.parād api hi yat padam.parād api ca yāḥ param.parād api ca yat padam. 10
paropakāraniratānirataḥparatā yeyaḥ svargasukhaniḥspṛhāḥ,nispṛhaḥnispṛhāḥ
jagaddhitāya janitāḥniratāsnirato sādhavas tv īdṛśātvādṛśātridaśa bhuvi.śuci 11

body.p:
evaṃ bhaṇitvā rājānaṃ punar abravīt: bho mahāsattva, tavā'haṃ
tuṣṭo 'smi, varaṃ vṛṣīṣva. rājñoktam: bho rākṣasa, tvam api mama
yadi prasanno jāto 'si, tarhy adyaprabhṛti manuṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ
parityaja. anyad api: mayo 'cyamānam upadeśaṃ śṛṇu. tathāyathā:

app.lem: yathā'tmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ, sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā;
app.rdg: tavā'tmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ, sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā;
tathaiva cātmanaḥ prāṇāḥ, sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā;
tavā'tmanaḥ priyāḥ guṇāḥ, sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā;

lg.l: tasmānasmān mṛtyubhayāt te 'pi trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ. 12
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃsatyaṃniśyat saṃsārasāgaresāgaram
kliśyanti jantavo ghore, mṛtyos trasyanti te yataḥ.martyās trasyanti mṛtyutaḥ.mṛtyos trasanti te yataḥ.mṛtyos trasyanti te trayaḥ.mṛtyos trasyanti nityaśaḥ. 13
mariṣyāmīkariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate,syāpi jāyatesyāpajāyate
śakyas tenāśaktyā tenāśakyate nā'numānena paro 'pi parirakṣitum.tad vaktuṃ kenacit kvacit. 14

yathātathā ca tetathāca tajte jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ,
tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyam;

saṃrakṣyate jīvitam ātmano yathā,saṃrakṣitaṃ jīvitam ātmano yathā,nirīkṣyate jīvitam ātmano yathā,
tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitam. 15

body.p:
iti rājñā nirūpito rākṣasas tadāprabhṛti prāṇijīvamāraṇaṃmaraṇaṃvadhaṃ tyaktvān;
rājā vikramo 'pi svanagaram agamat.

lg.l: anityāni śarīrāṇi, vibhavo naiva'pi na śāśvataḥ;
nityaṃ saṃnihito mṛtyuḥ; kartavyo dharmasaṃgrahaḥ. 1
śrūyatāṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ,dharmasvarūpaṃ yad uktaṃ śāstrokṭibhiḥ;granthakoṭibhiḥ
paropakāraḥ puṇyāya, pāpāya parapīḍanam. 2

app.lem: yo duḥkhitāni bhūtāni dṛṣṭvā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ,
app.rdg: duḥkhitāṃs tu narān dṛṣṭvā yo 'tyantaṃ duḥkhavān bhavet

lg.l: sukhitāni sukhī cāpi,vāpi sa dharmaṃ veda naiṣṭhikam.sa dharmātmeti śrūyatesa dharmo deva naiṣṭhikaḥ 3
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yaḥ prayacchati. 4
paramvaraṃ ekasya sattvasyasatrasyatrastasyasarvasyasaptasyamartyasya pradāturpradātuṃpradānaṃ jīvitaṃjīvituṃjīvitasya tu varam,
nasa ca viprasahasrebhyodadāty eva viprebhyo gosahasraṃsahasraṃ tu dine-dine.phalaṃ labhet 5
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ,
tasya dehavimuktasyapuṇyasya kalpāntedehaviyuktasya kṣayakṣayam eva na vidyate. 6
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvajīvadayāparaḥ.sarvajīve dayāparaḥsarvabhūtadayāparaḥ 7

app.lem: mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalam;

lg.l: dattvā'bhayaṃ athā'bhayaṃ dattāmayaārtābhayatamābhayaphalasyābhayapradānasyadānasyapradānaṃ ca kṣaya eva na vidyate.kalāṃ nā'rhati ṣoḍaśīm 8
sarvāṇy abhayadānasyasarvābhayapradānasyasarve 'bhayapradānasya kalāṃ nā'rhanti ṣoḍaśīm. 9
catuḥsāgaraparyantāṃparyantaṃ yo dadyād vasudhām imām,
yaś cāyasyā'bhayaṃ ca bhūtebhyas, tayor abhayadoubhayato 'dhikaḥ.varaḥniśaṃ 10
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā
dhruvaṃ yo nā'rjayed dharmaṃ, sa śocyopaśubhyosa vācyosa cebhyosa paśur mūḍhacetanaḥ.cetasaḥ 11
yadiyais tu prāṇyupakārāya deho 'yaṃdehaṃ yan nopayujyate,nopapūjyatena vimucyate
tataḥ kim upaka upakāro 'syakaro 'nyokaro vākāreṇa pratyahaṃ kriyate nṛbhiḥ?nṛṇām 12
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaraphaladakṣiṇāḥ,dakṣiṇam
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥprāṇināṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam. 13
sa saṃpadaṃ samāpnotisa saṃsadhaḥ samāpnotisa padaṃ samavāpnoti parād api ca yat param.yā parā 14
